# Synthetic Study on Edge-Cloud Academic Assistance

This document is intentionally synthetic and exists only to demonstrate the PaperAgent retrieval workflow. It does not reproduce a real paper.

## Abstract
We describe a hypothetical academic assistant that combines local edge inference with optional cloud retrieval. Privacy-sensitive writing operations are processed on-device, while literature-oriented question answering can use a user-configured cloud language model. The design separates local and remote execution paths, provides explicit configuration boundaries, and avoids embedding credentials or private datasets in source code.

## Method
The edge component offers grammar checking, academic polishing, and translation-oriented assistance. The cloud component reads a small document index, selects relevant records, condenses their contents, and generates a grounded answer. A reverse proxy exposes the components through one local entry point.

## Result
The synthetic workflow demonstrates how a competition package can retain the software architecture while excluding private credentials, model weights, real paper corpora, generated logs, and machine-specific configuration.

## Limitation
This record is not a scientific publication and must not be cited as research evidence.
